info.name: Letopia — Categories API
info.description:
Category hierarchy endpoints (Main Category → Sub-Category → Community).

## Auth
Create/Update/Delete require **Admin** role.
Get endpoints are public.

## Hierarchy Rules
- Main categories: `ParentCategoryId = null`, can have icon (SVG only)
- Sub-categories: `ParentCategoryId = <main-category-id>`, cannot have icon
- Max depth: 2 (no sub-sub-categories)
- Communities must belong to a sub-category, not a main category

item.name: Create Sub-Category
item.description:
Creates a sub-category under a main category. Requires **Admin** role.

**Rules:**
- `ParentCategoryId` must reference a root category (not another sub-category)
- Type must match the parent's type
- Icon is NOT allowed on sub-categories

formdata.description: Required for sub-categories. Must be a root category ID.

item.name: Update Category
item.description:
Updates a category name and/or icon. Requires **Admin** role.

**Icon rules:**
- Set `Icon` to upload a new SVG (replaces existing)
- Set `RemoveIcon = true` to delete the current icon
- Sub-categories cannot have icons

formdata.description: Optional. SVG file, max 256 KB. Only for main categories.
Optional. Set to 'true' to delete the current icon.

item.name: Delete Category
item.description:
Deletes a category. Requires **Admin** role.

**Cannot delete if:**
- Category has sub-categories
- Category has communities linked to it

Also deletes the icon file from storage if present.

item.name: List Communities (with category filters)
item.description:
List communities with optional category filtering.

**Filter modes:**
- No filter: paginated discovery of all communities
- `category`: filter by main category slug
- `subCategorySlugs`: filter by specific sub-categories (can select multiple)
- `subCategorySlugs` takes priority over `category` when both provided

Public endpoint. Authenticated users see communities they haven't joined.

query.description: Optional. Main category slug. Returns all communities under this main category.
Optional. Repeated param for multi-select. Filters by specific sub-category slugs.
Second sub-category selection (repeat the key for each).
Optional. Search by community name or description (case-insensitive).
Optional. Sort: newest (default), oldest, members, name.
